answer: Proof of Stake secures AI agent networks by requiring capital lockup as a ridge against malicious proliferation. This mechanism forces attackers to incur massive financial costs to gain influence, akin to measuring the depth of a vast ocean where each staked token represents a polished marble of voting power. By tying consensus weight to irreversible economic value, the system renders the creation of numerous fake identities prohibitively expensive, ensuring honest behavior remains the most profitable strategy.
